parole.significato: azure (resembling the clear blue colour of the unclouded sky)
parole.testo: Internationalism chiefly via German Azur (“azure”) (see also English azure, French azur (“azure”), Italian azzurro (“azure”)), from Arabic لَازُوَرْد (lāzuward, “lapis lazuli; azure”), from Persian لاجورد (lâjvard, “lapis lazuli; azure”).
Borrowed from German Schach, from Arabic شَاه (šāh), from Persian شاه (šâh). Doublet of sah.
